source.title: 2025 Engine and Transmission Diagnostic Parameter File Matrix

pdfUrls: https://gsi.ext.gm.com/gmspo/mode6/pdf/2025/2025 Engine & Transmission Diagnostic Parameter File Matrix.pdf

scopeRules: Rows establish a model-year, engine/transmission and diagnostic-file lookup; they do not establish that every code in a file applies to every listed vehicle.
Model labels are preserved as printed. Multiple makes or models in a cell are not expanded into inferred make/model/engine Cartesian products.
The OBDII group column contains merged and blank cells. groupAsPrinted is retained without guessing values from nearby rows.
Exact filename matches may supply file-level candidate makes. Mismatched filenames require further verification before joining code mentions to applications.
All recorded code mentions remain unreviewed source candidates. Causes, thresholds, procedures and repairs require individual section review.
